Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for pilot order (FederalEd)

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for the demo last week. FederalEd is lining up a small pilot across three school districts (procurement code 7-B). Their fiscal disbursements are organized quarterly and they can only cut payment on a net-90 cadence for pilot contracts under $250k unless there is an exception approved by their finance committee.

We'd like to request: a conditional Net-90 payment term for the pilot (three quarters), and quarterly invoicing to match their budget release schedule. They can issue the PO immediately once terms are aligned (attached PO stub + budget calendar).

A couple constraints from their side:
- No physical ACH mandate until the committee signoff (so they will email-wire per invoice)
- They ask for a usage true-up clause at the end of each quarter (we can bill overages on the next invoice)

Attaching the PO and their budget calendar for reference. Please let me know what information you need for internal approvals.

Best,
Elena
Director of Procurement
FederalEd Consortium

Thanks for the details and the attachments. I've looped in our sales ops and finance partners to start an internal approval thread. A few quick clarifying questions so we can scope mitigations for exec review:

1) Estimated pilot spend across the three districts for the first 90 days? (ballpark is fine)
2) Any PO netting or consolidated invoicing preference (one invoice per quarter for the consortium vs. district-level invoices)?

Grace / Marissa —

Thanks for the ping, Grace. Quick summary from my side after reviewing the PO and the calendar:
- Estimated pilot spend: ~$98k for Q1 (consortium consolidated), with variable overages depending on token usage
- FederalEd prefers a single consolidated invoice per quarter to simplify approvals
- They requested SOC2 Type II report availability and a point of contact for security attestation (they won't run a full questionnaire for the pilot but need a statement)

Marissa — finance authorization request: We are asking for a conditional Net-90 for the first three quarters of the pilot, with these proposed mitigations:
1) 1% early-pay discount if they pay within 30 days
2) Usage cap of 125% of the estimated Q spend; overages bill on next invoice
3) Contract includes a right-to-stop clause if outstanding invoices exceed 60 days past due beyond the conditional window
4) DocuSign execution with PO attached; Redwood to provide SOC2 link before first invoice

Elena / Markus — if that package is acceptable, I'll prepare a short one-page amendment for exec review. Grace — can you confirm that consolidated billing is workable for FederalEd?

Thanks for the context and the proposed mitigations. I approve a conditional Net-90 cadence for the pilot under the following executive conditions: 

1) Conditional window: first three quarters only (review after Q3)
2) Early-pay discount: 1% if payment received within 30 days of invoice
3) Usage cap: 125% of estimated quarterly spend; overages invoiced on next cycle
4) Security: Redwood will provide our SOC2 Type II report link and a named security contact prior to first invoice
5) Escalation/Safeguards: If invoices are unpaid beyond 60 days after the end of the conditional window, Redwood reserves the right to suspend service and move to prepay or stop-ship terms for subsequent procurement
6) Legal: Standard SOW amendment to include the above plus the PO attachment; Marissa to finalize amendment and DocuSign routing

Please proceed with the one-page amendment (Marissa) and route for signature. Grace, once DocuSign is out, copy me and I'll confirm final acceptance. Deal id: RDW-5482.
